name: Ozen – Hebrew Transcription
subtitle: Speech to text, fully offline
promotionalText: Record, share a WhatsApp voice note, or import a file — and get a Hebrew transcript in seconds. No internet, no servers.
description:
Ozen turns spoken Hebrew into text, right on your iPhone. Your recordings and transcripts never leave the device — no uploads, no account, no subscription.

What you can do:
• Record a meeting, lecture or idea and get a transcript split into timestamped paragraphs
• Share a WhatsApp voice note straight to Ozen
• Import audio files (m4a, mp3, wav, opus and more)
• Search, edit, rename, and play back from any paragraph
• Copy with one tap, or export as text or Markdown
• Keep recording with the screen locked, with controls in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen

Fully private: the speech recognition model runs on the device itself and works in airplane mode. Ozen collects no data.

Under the hood: Ozen-v1, a small, fast Hebrew speech recognition model distilled from an ivrit.ai model.
